mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_upload_requests (token_hash, user_id, agent_id, repository_id, skill_name, version, description, tags, category, type, expected_commit, manifest_json, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{repositoryId}, #{skillName}, #{version}, #{description}, #{tags}, #{category}, #{type}, #{expectedCommit}, #{manifestJson}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, token_hash, user_id, agent_id, repository_id, skill_name, version, description, tags, category, type, expected_commit, manifest_json, status, expires_at, decided_at, created_at FROM skill_upload_requests WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_upload_requests SET status = #{status}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE skill_upload_requests SET status = 'CREATING' WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND agent_id = #{agentId} AND repository_id IS NULL AND status = 'APPROVED' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
